limitations: All profiles and trajectories are fictional; this is conditional simulation validation, not clinical or external validation.
The primary monitoring workflow assumes 85% daily observation probability. It is not measured TOLIFE coverage.
Ongoing low readings are included. Recall for transitions from a currently non-low reading is only 13.48%; this is not established early incident deterioration prediction.
Future missing readings are unknown, not negatives. Accuracy applies only to eligible decisions with an observed next-day target.
17 static EHR inputs and dynamic measurements are jointly ingested. No full-minus-EHR ablation was predeclared, so incremental EHR benefit is unestablished.
No seven-day exacerbation probability, treatment recommendation or real-patient forecast is produced.

available.interpretation: Conditional synthetic next-day measurement forecast. Ongoing low readings included; not a COPD exacerbation or clinically validated early-warning probability.
